name: Gasthof Schönau
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on a hillside in Erl, Gasthof Schoenau welcomes travellers with comfortable guestrooms and hearty Tyrolean fare. Wide panoramas overlooking the Inn Valley invite pure relaxation.

The Erl Festival Hall, hiking trails across the Kaiser range, and Kufstein Fortress are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Schoenau in Erl provides traditional hospitality and valley vistas in the festival village.
